card.text: WASP-2 b was found in 2007 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-2b"
sources.quote: WASP-2b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star WASP-2 located about 500 light years away in the constellation of Delphinus.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-2. Its orbit and size follow Addison et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-2b"
sources.quote: It was discovered via the transit method, and then follow up measurements using the radial velocity method confirmed that WASP-2b was a planet.
